title: Hourly weather at a place from Open-Meteo's historical weather API: 2 m temperature, precipitation and 10 m wind speed, from reanalyses
provider: Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com), Historical Weather API, from ECMWF's reanalyses (ERA5, ERA5-Land) and the IFS analyses of the Copernicus Climate Change Service, its 'best match' of models
credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), from Copernicus ERA5
licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo's terms for its API data); the free API is for non-commercial use, within 10,000 calls a day. The reanalyses beneath: Copernicus licence (free, attribution).
citation: Zippenfenig, P. (2023), Open-Meteo.com Weather API, Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7970649 ; Hersbach, H. et al. (2020), The ERA5 global reanalysis, Q. J. R. Meteorol. Soc. 146, 1999-2049; Muñoz Sabater, J. (2019), ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present, Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store
format: JSON: latitude, longitude and elevation of the model's grid point; hourly.time (ISO 8601, UTC with timezone=GMT), hourly.temperature_2m (deg C, at the instant), hourly.precipitation (mm, the sum over the preceding hour), hourly.wind_speed_10m (m/s with wind_speed_unit=ms, at the instant); null where a model has no value
coverage: Any place, 1940 to about two to five days before the present (ERA5T); the default place is Melbourne's CBD, whose nearest grid point is -37.7856, 144.9398 (19 m), about 3.6 km north-west

latitude.description: Latitude of the place, degrees north (WGS 84)

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, degrees east

end.description: Last day (UTC); the default, yesterday, is the latest complete day

melbourne.description: Melbourne's CBD (-37.8136, 144.9631), every hour from 1 January 2009 to yesterday, about 4 MB
